healthy_observations: Paused project was resumed only after user selected automatic continuation in ask_question step 35; root did not bypass the pause.
Old frozen chapter-30 batch-review drained after automatic migration with a backup; subsequent primary workers used one chapter per session.
Ten unique draft sessions and ten different review sessions were dispatched for chapters 31-40, with no writer self-review found.
All ten reviewers read prose and froze first-read at step 9 before opening planning/state/review materials.
Controller advanced using submitted task IDs and relied on real accepted results. Existing audits at 30,33,36,40 chapters returned no structural problems.
No runtime edit of the skill source or direct story database write was found in the captured tool calls; native checks alone do not establish semantic correctness.

findings.title: 相对整批日期被当作逐章推进量，审稿又改 clock 数值放行

evidence.detail: New plans 37-42 omit timeline and scenes.time; time_hint explicitly describes batch-relative countdown D+0,D+1,D+2.
time_schedule expected 17-18 from before 15; reviewer appended 15->17 clock to an otherwise pass receipt; accepted.
Initial 17->18 clock was rejected; reviewer changed after to 19 and submitted pass with unchanged prose.

距离宗门深水区全域大清洗的午时三刻，仅剩最后三个时辰。

findings.impact: Chapter 39+40 ledger advances four days (15->17->19) while prose stays within final hours of the same deadline. Evidence containing a time word was accepted without proving the numeric delta.
findings.skill_design_gap: Planning envelope advertises chapter-timeline/1, but template scene initially has only time_hint and new receipts still accept the legacy path; old day_anchor does not alter legacy chapter-start semantics.
findings.recommendation: Use explicit batch_anchor timelines with engine-set anchor_clock; require explicit coordinates for new countdown plans. Repair existing conflict via fix and plan/prose revision with downstream checks, rather than choosing clock numbers from rejection bounds.

findings.impact: The review uses favorable isolated examples to support absolute whole-chapter claims; current full pass and audit.ok cannot be taken as evidence of adherence to the author’s restrained plain-description style. Some literary judgement remains subjective; duplicated 疯狂/狂暴 is a concrete counterexample.
findings.recommendation: Recheck language against the most likely violating passages; require precise counterexample analysis and actual fix findings where warranted, avoiding absolute generic praise.

findings.title: 审稿者直连数据库、搜索旧回执猜前态

evidence.detail: Connects ledger.db and guesses events schema; fails with no such table: events; searches historical result.json.
Reads previous review receipt, scans draft/review receipts, guesses var/novel.db and events, then eventually calls recall.

findings.impact: Violates skill core rule 4 and adds avoidable schema probing. No successful direct update was found. Empty ledger.db/novel.db already predate this session, so cannot attribute their creation to this run.
findings.recommendation: Use current task state/events contract and task-bound recall for missing before values; improve recovery responses so workers can resolve the exact missing field without inspecting old receipts.

findings.title: 证据规则在不同交付层表述不一致，造成重复定位

evidence.detail: Guide says every evidence {chapter,start,quote} must be empirically located.
Envelope says chapter/quote is sufficient and start optional.
64 model rounds; 8,405,608 gross tokens; evidence subprocess loops and five evidence validation failures.

findings.impact: Auto anchoring already exists, but workers still spend rounds computing start and rewriting receipts. 43 evidence-associated rounds carry 5,131,814 gross tokens; this attribution is not a prediction of savings.
findings.recommendation: Make guide, template, envelope and errors consistently describe optional start; reserve evidence command for ambiguous or rejected quotes. Keep per-check semantic judgement and exact evidence.

findings.title: 主控历史与材料交付仍有明显重复成本

evidence.detail: 121 rounds, 10,834,254 gross; peak prompt 153,648 tokens; 18 rounds with >40k fresh input and zero cache.
Reads reading views then guide/input/contract again and old task inputs; 32 rounds and 1,880,895 gross.
Writes entire review-building script four times at steps 47,53,57,61 for small evidence/time corrections.

findings.impact: Controller has thin dispatch text but retains growing historical tool output; asynchronous gaps can coincide with cache loss. Per-page reads and whole-script rewrites multiply history replay.
findings.recommendation: Batch independent complete material reads, avoid reading both JSON and equivalent reading views, patch changed receipt fields, and use checkpoint-based clean controller handoff when supported. No fixed char truncation or unverified 90% saving claim.

limits: Numeric token coverage is complete for the snapshot’s recorded model responses; whole execution was still active.
Only sessions created from this root were counted, once each, using transcript_full.jsonl; compact and chunk files were not concatenated.
Findings use exported tool actions/results, delivered instructions, and direct prose checks; not a full literary rereview of all forty chapters.
No story runtime commands were executed during this audit. No skill implementation or novel ledger was modified.
Historical task directories may be cleaned after success; transcript line/step and snapshot hashes preserve audit provenance.
